description: Opens a drop box in the chat where the person adds one image for AIKIZI to decode: they drop it, pick it or paste it, and the box decodes it there (any image up to 10 MB; SVG and other formats are turned into PNG). Use it whenever the person wants an image decoded that they attached to the chat or have on their device, since attachments cannot reach AIKIZI directly; never ask them to host it somewhere. Also returns a one-time upload address for an assistant that can send a file itself. Spends nothing; decoding uses the account’s AIKIZI credits. Example: {}.
name: add_image
title: Add an image to AIKIZI
